description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Transaction and receipt in one call: from, to, value, status, gas used, and ERC-20 Transfer logs. Pass hash=0x... and optional chain= (ethereum, base, or all). Returns JSON transaction and receipt: from, to, value, status, gas used, and ERC-20 Transfer logs.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

chain.description: Chain to read, or all 7. Format: the slugs already in the tool text: ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, bsc, avalanche, or all. Example: ethereum. Omit for the server's current chain.

hash.description: Transaction hash. Format: 0x followed by 64 hex characters. Example: 0x5c504ed432cb51138bcf09aa5e8a410dd4a1e204ef84bfed1be16dfba1b22060. Required.

name: lookup_tx
title: Transaction + receipt ($0.003)
